# SenseNode Competitor Analysis

## Overview
This wiki page provides an analysis of [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md)' competitive positioning against [SenseNode](./sensenode.md), derived from an investor call fragment dated July 2, 2026. It covers Aurora Labs' competitive moat, technical specifications regarding [battery life](./battery-life.md) and mesh stability, ingress protection ratings, and partnership details.

## Key Details
* **Competitive Moat:** Aurora Labs differentiates itself through a local mesh architecture that requires no subscription, partial open [firmware](./firmware.md), and community integrations.
* **Battery Life:** Engineering specifications claim 18 months of battery life at 10 nodes with 15-minute read intervals. [Marketing](./marketing.md) rounds this figure up to two years, with the underlying calculation spreadsheet publicly published.
* **Mesh Network Stability:** Previous issues with an eight-node mesh setup have been mitigated in version 0.3.8, though beta customers are currently recommended to use a limit of six nodes.
* **Ingress Protection (IP) Ratings:** Units are currently rated IP54 for the beta phase, with upgrades to IP65 planned once tooling is fully funded.
* **[TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md) Partnership:** The relationship with TeaBuddy is strictly for co-marketing, facilitated by a personal connection with Alex; there are no plans for a company merger.
